Jordan: Heads-up. AE flagged a procurement requirement: Blue Harbor wants a 90-day Dedicated pilot invoiced upfront, asking for 28% off list. PO will be issued today but procurement insists on an invoice (cannot accept credits).
Maya: Share the numbers please. 28% is above our standard pilot discount. Any conversion signal or commit?
Jordan: List price = $50k/mo, pilot price at 28% off = $36k/mo -> $108k total. No commit in PO. They said vendor comparison returned 30% off from competitor.
Ethan: Per deal-desk, any discount >20% needs RevOps and CFO sign-off. Also need to tag invoice with a special revenue code "pilot_discount_blueharbor" for reporting.
Rina: Legal: if Finance approves, require SOW addendum stating the 90-day pilot is standalone and conversion to committed pricing needs a separate signed agreement. Add data access limitations and pilot SLA disclaimer.
Jordan: Customer won't accept conditional credits or refundable invoices; they need a standard invoice for audit.
BillingBot: billing-bot created draft invoice INV-2026-0588 for $36,000/mo. Draft link: https://billing.internal/invoices/INV-2026-0588
Maya: Margin watch: At 28% discount, margin becomes narrow if usage spikes. Recommend a hard usage cap (suggest 200k tokens/day) or auto-reprice clause beyond cap. Can sales add cap into PO?
Jordan: I'll ask AE to include daily cap and automatic re-rate on excess usage.
CFO_Kim: I can approve up to 20% pilot discount for a maximum of 90 days if: 1) usage cap and auto-reprice are in place, 2) invoice is tagged for analytics, and 3) Legal SOW addendum is signed. For 28% we need Exec level exception; Jordan escalate with strategic ROI and projected enterprise ACV uplift.
Maya: I'll prepare the reconciliation tag and schedule monthly usage checkpoints.
Jordan: Escalating now with ARR uplift rationale and EMEA expansion priority. Will update when PO amendment comes through. :thumbsup:
